_comment: The training course's lessons (MISSION-TRAINING.md, SPEC.md §15; M47). Each lesson is its own small situation and a list of steps, and src/lessons.js lets only what a step lists do anything. `start`: `men` by roster id (`at`, and optionally `ap`, `charges`, `hits`, `hidden`; a man not named is not on the board), `enemies` in the map's own shape, `parachutes` ({ at, unit }), `turn`, `alert`. A step: `say`, the pen's line on the board (seven words at most) at hex `at` (or under the man it is about); `tell`, the lesson card's words: what he is looking at, the rule in its numbers, what to do; `ring`, hexes to ring, or "men"; `allow`: { select: [ids] or true, move: [hexes] or "any", actions: [ids], endTurn }; `until`: what ends the step, one of the kinds listed in src/lessons.js; `mayBeSeen` where being spotted is the lesson. M47 had lessons 3 and 5, to prove the engine; M48 adds 2 and 4 and rewords all four (the operator's: say the rule plainly, with its number). Lesson 1 and 6 to 15 are still to come.

steps.tell: Every man lands on his parachute and leaves it where he lands. Barrow is standing on his: the canopy in the corner of his hex.
A patrol finds any parachute it walks onto or past, and the alert goes up by 1. Hover the patrol on the drive: the dotted line is the beat it walks.
Packing a parachute costs 1 AP, and then there is nothing to find. A man must be standing on the parachute to pack it.

steps.say: VANCE'S IS BY THE DRIVE. GO THERE.
steps.tell: Any man can pack any parachute. This one lies beside the patrol's beat, so it would be found. Move Barrow onto it.
That is the choice on every drop: packing costs AP, and a parachute left lying costs alert when it is found.
Each counter is one of your men. Click a man to select him.
The dots on his counter are his action points (AP): he has 3 each turn. Open grass costs 1 AP a hex. Hover the ringed hex to see what the move costs, then click it.
He has spent 2 AP and has 1 left. AP not used are lost when the turn ends, and every man starts the next turn with all of his again.

steps.say: A HEDGE COSTS TWO. GO THERE.
steps.tell: He has 3 AP again. Rough ground costs more: a hedge is 2 AP a hex, and hides him better than open grass.
Ground does two things: it costs AP to cross, and it gives cover. Vance is a scout, with 4 AP.
The box under the map describes whatever the mouse is on. Its GROUND line gives the cost and the cover: a wood is 2 AP a hex and heavy cover.
Marsh is 3 AP a hex and only light cover. The number on each hex of the path is the AP spent by the time he gets there.
Grass and tracks are 1 AP a hex, and neither gives any cover. Move him onto the drive, by the bridge.
Nobody can walk through water. The only way over the brook on foot is the bridge: 1 AP, no cover.
The ‘SENTRY’ umpire by the brook is looking this way. The faint red ground in front of him is what he can see.
With a man selected, the ground he can reach is tinted. Red: he would be spotted going there. Blue: he would not. Hover a hex and the box under the map says why.
The dots on a path are how well he is seen: at 3 he is spotted. A hedge is heavy cover and takes 2 dots off. Move him into it. End the turn on red ground and the umpire blows his whistle.
Going to ground (‘H’ for ‘Hide’) makes him harder still to see, and ends his turn. He stays hidden until he next moves.
